help.title: Up Sample
help.body:
Description
Up-Sampling Imbalanced Data. Keeps all rows and adds randomly chosen repeats of rows (sampling with replacement) to each class of the selected variable until it has as many rows as the largest class, so that the class distributions are equal.
Usage
BSkyUpSample(data, dependent)
Arguments
  • data: a data frame
  • dependent: the name of the variable whose classes (levels or distinct values) are balanced, as a character string
Details
All the original rows are kept, and additional rows are sampled with replacement from the minority class(es). Rows where the selected variable is missing (NA) are left out, with a warning. Factor levels that no row has are ignored. Set seed makes the result reproducible.
Value
A data frame with the same columns, in the same order, as the original dataset. Rows keep their original order, with the repeated rows next to the rows they copy.
Examples
set.seed(12345)
UpSample <- BSkyUpSample(data = Dataset2, dependent = "gender")
table(UpSample$gender)
Package
BlueSky
Help
help(BSkyUpSample, package ='BlueSky')
